ssdd.name: Official SSDD (SAR Ship Detection Dataset), official release
ssdd.license: Apache-2.0 (as stated on the GitHub repository)
ssdd.citation: T. Zhang et al., "SAR Ship Detection Dataset (SSDD): Official Release and Comprehensive Data Analysis," Remote Sens., 13(18), 3690, 2021. https://doi.org/10.3390/rs13183690

xview3.access: free account required (AWS Cognito login); label CSVs direct; scenes via personal signed links valid a few hours (aria2 lists). Save lists + CSVs into data/raw/xview3/ manually.
xview3.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2020); do not redistribute download links
xview3.citation: F. Paolo et al., "xView3-SAR: Detecting Dark Fishing Activity Using Synthetic Aperture Radar Imagery," NeurIPS 2022 Datasets and Benchmarks.
downloaded_files: validation.tar (= shoreline/validation.tar.gz, gzip; saved under this name; not extracted)

sarfish.access: public, ungated Hugging Face repos (original ESA GRD+SLC SAFE zips of all 753 xView3 scenes); labels only via login-gated xView3 page
sarfish.license: Apache-2.0 (HF card); labels follow xView3 terms
sarfish.size: GRD zips 0.53-1.21 GB each, 673 GB total GRD; full dataset 3293 GB compressed
sarfish.citation: C. Luckett et al., "The SARFish Dataset and Challenge," WACV Workshops 2024.

gfw_paolo2024_training.citation: F. S. Paolo et al., "Satellite mapping reveals extensive industrial activity at sea," Nature 625, 85-91 (2024).

needs: map_reveal (AIS-matched SAR detections by GFW; model predictions, not ground truth, not raw AIS)

planetary_computer_s1_grd.license: Copernicus Sentinel data terms (free, attribution); Planetary Computer terms of use
planetary_computer_s1_grd.notes: COG per polarisation, uint16 DN in radar geometry with GCPs; item ids omit the 4-char product suffix

copernicus_data_space.access: OData/STAC catalogue anonymous; downloads need free account + OAuth token (never commit credentials)
copernicus_data_space.license: Copernicus Sentinel data terms (free, full and open)

gfw_api.access: free self-service registration; personal API token; 50k requests/day, 1.5M/month
gfw_api.license: non-commercial, CC BY-NC 4.0 (API terms); dataset-specific restrictions apply

dma_ais.access: public S3 listing (http://aisdata.ais.dk.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com); 2020 as monthly zips (~15-17 GB), recent years as daily zips (~0.6-0.75 GB)
dma_ais.license: see !_README_information_CSV_files.txt and DMA terms (not reviewed in detail)

lseg_workspace.status: access_tested (desktop session); suitable only for recent dates, commercial-fleet subset
lseg_workspace.name: LSEG Workspace (Eikon) vessel data via LSEG Data Library for Python
lseg_workspace.access: desktop session: Workspace desktop app running + logged in on the same machine (Data API Proxy 127.0.0.1:9000); EIKON_APP_KEY in git-ignored .env (never commit)
endpoints_used: get_data TR.AssetLocation*/TR.Asset* fields with SDate/EDate (day resolution)
lseg_workspace.limits: 5 req/s, 10,000 req/day, 50 MB/min, 5 GB/day (local throttling endpoint); Search top+skip <= 10,000
lseg_workspace.license: LSEG Workspace terms: licensed for individual use; do not commit or redistribute data; display rights in our app unverified

lseg_vessel_tracking_api.status: located_not_tested (no VESSEL_TRACKING_API_KEY; endpoint answers 401 without credentials)
lseg_vessel_tracking_api.endpoint: GET https://vtracking.rdms.refinitiv.com/api/v1/Shipping/History (one IMO/RIC/ENI per call; Authorization: apikey-v1 <key>)
lseg_vessel_tracking_api.notes: documented history = most recent 24 h only; separate key/product; Eikon app key not assumed to work
